visual_species: Cyprinus carpio, scaled common carp visual study

observations: robust gold-brown scaled body with arched back and paler belly
blunt subterminal mouth with two pairs of tapered barbels
long dorsal, small posterior anal and deeply emarginate caudal

anatomical_reference.scope: Scaled gold-brown common carp, not mirror or leather carp. USGS overview simplifies visible barbels; the FAO diagnostic specifies two pairs, including the short upper-lip pair, used here.
